_doc: Echoes of the Logos battle sprite roster: every enemy's sprite family, every boss's own sprite, with briefs for the artist. Source of truth for enemies.json spriteId and sprites.json; apply with art/apply_sprite_roster.py. Spec: ../voice-rpg-engine/docs/SPRITE_PLAN.md.
style: 16-bit SNES-era JRPG battle sprite, side view, facing RIGHT (the engine mirrors enemies to face the party).
Match the delivered heroes and templates: limited palette (4-8 colours per sprite), 1 px dark outline, no anti-aliasing, transparent background.
Cell 64x64 for regular enemies (the body about 40-56 px tall); bosses 96x96 or 128x128 as listed.

Soles on the same row in every frame (row 58 of a 64 cell, 90 of 96, 122 of 128); floating creatures put their lowest point or hover shadow there. The feet slice's bottom edge is the sole line (scripts/sprite_lint.py checks it).
Nothing but the character in a frame: no labels, frame names or text (sprite_lint removes them, but don't rely on it).
Frame duration 190 ms unless a move needs faster frames; events in the tag user data, counted from 1 within the tag.

recommended: windup (4f loop: the telegraphed wind-up before a move)
cast (5f, release=4: magic or ranged moves)
death (6f: if absent the engine shatters the sprite)

required: charge_ultimate (4f loop: charging its ultimate over a turn)
recommended: p2_idle, p2_attack... (second phase after its health threshold)

families.name: Obsidian Brute
families.look: Hulking soldier in dark spiked plate with a heavy axe (delivered).

members.variant: royal garrison captain: crimson tabard over the plate, gold trim, plumed helm
Vaelor's garrison: glossy obsidian-black plate with violet lamp-glow highlights
the guild's voiceless warden: dull grey plate, mouth sealed by a stitched leather strap
Malakor's gatekeeper: ash-grey and bone-white plate, silver mesh mouth-guard like Malakor's

families.name: Hooded Marksman
families.look: Crouched hooded crossbow marksman (delivered).

members.variant: blighted hunter: sickly green-brown leathers, rot spots
royal arbalest: red and steel livery
obsidian-black cloak with violet trim
swamp hunter: mossy green camouflage cloak, reeds in the hood

families.name: Hooded Occultist
families.look: Dark hooded robed caster with a glowing staff (delivered).

members.variant: indigo robes, void-blue staff glow
crimson and gold court robes
bone-white robes, skull mask, pale green glow
grave-pale robes with green soulfire
grey robes, sealed lips, a hanging lantern
deep-sea teal robes speckled with glowing stolen voice-motes
translucent violet shade of a guild mage
ash-grey robes, chained book at the belt
white and gold vestments, golden censer glow
gold-leaf robes hung with coins

families.name: Shadow Wisp
families.look: Small floating shadow spirit, about 30 px tall: a ragged leafy body of black-green smoke, one glowing violet eye, small bat wings, a wispy tail instead of legs. Hovers with a faint shadow on the sole line (see portraits/shadow_wisp.jpg).
families.moves: attack: darts forward and bites; cast: spits a violet shadow bolt.

families.name: Blighted Orc
families.look: Broad grey-green orc warrior covered in sickly blight boils, crude rusted cleaver, bone-and-hide armour, hunched shoulders.

members.variant: leaner tracker with a fur cloak and darker skin, a hunting knife in place of the cleaver (recolour is enough)

families.name: Brood Spider
families.look: Low, wide giant arachnid (about 30 px tall, 56 px long) with razor foreclaws, a bloated abdomen, clusters of red eyes, glossy black-purple chitin dripping obsidian venom. Offspring of the Broodmothers.
families.moves: attack: rears and slashes with the foreclaws; cast: spits a venom glob.

members.variant: white web-silk draped over the body, pale violet sheen
a hatchling: bright toxic green, drawn smaller (sprites.json scale 0.75)

families.name: Black Guild Assassin
families.look: Lithe masked assassin of the Black Guild: charcoal wrappings, a half-face mask, silver-threaded obsidian kunai, crouched forward stance (Zephyr's former brothers).
families.moves: attack: dashing double slash; cast: throws a fan of kunai.

members.variant: a poisoned blade dripping green
void indigo wrappings with a faint blue glow
a garrote wire between the hands instead of kunai, heavier build
a translucent violet shade, smoke trailing from the edges

families.name: Crypt Skeleton
families.look: Skeletal legionnaire in a rusted half-helm and scraps of a purple burial tabard, notched sword and round shield.
families.moves: attack: shield bash into a sword thrust.

families.name: Skeletal Sniper
families.look: Skeleton archer with a long yew bow, tattered purple hood, a quiver of black-fletched arrows.
families.moves: attack and cast: draws and looses an arrow (impact/release on the loose).

families.name: Silt Ghoul
families.look: Hunched, mud-caked ghoul with long clawed arms, hollow glowing eyes, ragged burial cloth, dripping grey silt.

members.variant: a drowned pilgrim: waterlogged pale-blue skin, seaweed and pilgrim beads
candle-wax drips on the shoulders, longer grasping arms

families.name: Penitent Templar
families.look: Undead templar knight in cracked gilded plate with a sun emblem, bound in iron chains, a hollow-eyed helm leaking violet light; carries a greatsword (Galahault's fallen order).
families.moves: attack: two-handed downward greatsword strike; cast: holy-violet flash from the sun emblem.

members.variant: darker tarnished plate, broken sword, heavier chains

families.name: Spectral Reaper
families.look: Floating hooded wraith in tattered purple-black robes with no legs, skeletal hands, a long scythe, cold violet eyes; hovers with its robe tips above the sole line.
families.moves: attack: wide scythe sweep; cast: a spectral bolt from the hand.

members.variant: void indigo, more translucent, no scythe-glint

families.name: Clockwork Ironclad
families.look: Clockwork knight automaton: riveted barrel chest, visible gears at the joints, glowing core behind a grille, tower shield and a piston mace; stiff, mechanical stance.
families.moves: attack: piston-driven mace slam; cast: core vents a steam burst.

members.variant: polished brass with a larger shield
moss and rust, swamp weed caught in the gears
verdigris bronze with razor claws in place of the mace
obsidian-black plating, red core
obsidian-black plating, violet core

families.name: Clockwork Tripod
families.look: Three-legged clockwork walker with a turret body and a mounted steam ballista; brass boiler, smoking chimney.
families.moves: attack and cast: the ballista recoils and fires a bolt.

members.variant: a flame nozzle in place of the ballista, orange-hot boiler

families.name: Walking Obelisk
families.look: A rune-carved stone monolith on stubby stone legs, runes glowing as it gathers power, a single eye-rune near the top.
families.moves: attack: topples forward and slams; cast: fires a beam from the eye-rune.

members.variant: white-gold crystal spire, golden runes, no legs (floats)
a mirror-faced obelisk in a silver frame, the party's doubts flickering in the glass

families.name: Trench Leech
families.look: A blind giant leech rearing up from the floor, segmented slick body, a round toothed maw, knotted with faintly glowing motes of stolen voices.
families.moves: attack: lunges and latches with the maw; cast: spits a glob.

members.variant: swamp brown-green
void indigo

families.name: Thorn Choir Druid
families.look: Antlered forest druid in a cloak of leaves and thorns, a briar staff, glowing green eyes; corrupted guardian of the grove.
families.moves: cast: raises the briar staff and lashes thorns forward.

members.variant: glass-vine cloak, mouth open in song, obsidian venom streaks
void-tainted purple thorns, Inquisition chains on the staff

families.name: Glassvine Colossus
families.look: A massive walking golem of braided vines and bark (fills most of the cell), crystalline glass shards growing from the vines, glowing green heart in the chest.
families.moves: attack: a heavy two-armed vine slam.

members.variant: thorny bark, no glass, a moss crown

families.name: Void Tendril
families.look: A single thick tentacle rising out of a dark pool on the floor, suckers along its length, a hooked tip, dripping liquid silence.
families.moves: attack: whips down and lashes; cast: flings a glob of void.

members.variant: a gnarled green root rising from moss instead of a pool

families.name: Archon Custodian
families.look: Golden armoured celestial sentinel with folded light-wings, a faceless gold helm, a halberd of solidified harmonic light.
families.moves: attack: halberd thrust; cast: a ring of light from the wings.

members.variant: a gilded reflection: polished mirror-gold, coins in the wing feathers

families.name: Echo Nullifier
families.look: Silent Inquisition enforcer: grey high-collared coat, a stitched leather mask with no mouth, sound-dampening discs on a bandolier.
families.moves: attack and cast: hurls a humming silencing disc.

members.variant: paler grey, a hissing silver mouth-grille

bosses.name: Grave Broodmother
bosses.look: Colossal arachnid queen crawling from a vaulted ceiling: bone-white carapace etched like grave stones, a swollen egg sac with hatchlings clinging to her back, eight barbed legs, a crown of eyes.
bosses.moves: attack: Bite (lunging fangs); cast: Spawn Hatchlings (the egg sac bursts); charge_ultimate / ultimate: Venomous Brood Cataclysm (rears up, venom raining from her abdomen).

bosses.name: Blighted Broodmother
bosses.look: The Grave Broodmother corrupted: glossy obsidian chitin dripping black venom, glowing green blight veins. A recolour of grave_broodmother is enough (deliver blighted_broodmother.json only if it should differ in shape).

bosses.name: Bog Behemoth
bosses.look: A towering swamp titan of mud, roots and rotting willow bark, moss hanging from its shoulders, glowing corrosive-green eyes and maw, one arm a club of tangled roots.
bosses.moves: attack: Trample (a stomp); cast: Bog Breath (acid breath); charge_ultimate / ultimate: Primeval Tectonic Tremor (both fists into the ground, the floor splitting).

bosses.name: Ancient Mire Wyrm
bosses.look: An ancient serpentine wyrm rising out of the silt (lower body submerged at the sole line), mud-plated scales, a fanned crest, corrosive yellow eyes.
bosses.moves: attack: Tail Lash; cast: Silt Breath; charge_ultimate / ultimate: Acidic Silt Torrent (rears high, a torrent of acid silt from the jaws).

bosses.name: Grand Executioner Kaelen
bosses.look: A massive hooded executioner of the Inquisition: black leather hood, bare scarred arms, a blood-red sash, twin heavy execution axes; Black Guild sigil on the belt.
bosses.moves: attack: Executioner Cut (cross-chop with both axes); cast: Shadow Fan (hurls a fan of shadow blades); Blink Strike (vanishes in smoke and reappears); charge_ultimate / ultimate: Headsman's Crimson Guillotine (axes raised overhead, a crimson arc).

bosses.name: Sir Galahault, the Obsidian Grandmaster
bosses.look: Petrified golden paladin (portraits/galahault.jpg): golden plate cracked through with black obsidian veins, a sun emblem on the breastplate, a plumed golden helm, a greatsword; tattered golden cape.
bosses.moves: attack: Oathbreaker Smite; cast: Dawn Judgment (sun emblem flares); Petrified Aegis (crouch behind the sword, stone creeping over the gold); charge_ultimate / ultimate: Eclipse of the Corrupted Dawn (sword raised, the sun emblem eclipsed black).

bosses.name: Master Nocturne
bosses.look: Spymaster of the Mute (portraits/nocturne.jpg): tall, deep purple hood and laced dark leathers, pale face, violet smoke curling around him, many hidden blades.
bosses.moves: attack: Silent Kill (vanishing lunge); cast: Murder of Blades (a spray of kunai); charge_ultimate / ultimate: Thousand Blade Umbral Requiem (rises into smoke, blades orbiting him).

bosses.name: Clockwork Warmaster Ouros
bosses.look: Iron Bastion Sovereign (portraits/ouros.jpg): a towering crowned brass-and-iron automaton king, glowing orange eyes, gears and steam pipes on the shoulders, a gear-toothed greataxe.
bosses.moves: attack: Gear Cleave; Overdrive (vents steam, core glowing); cast: Bellow of Iron (chest grille opens, electric shockwave); charge_ultimate / ultimate: Omega Core Cataclysm Beam (core opens, a beam from the chest).

bosses.name: Commander Vaelor, the Voice-Thief
bosses.look: Hand of Malakor (portraits/vaelor.jpg): grey-haired commander in black spiked plate and a black cape, a longsword and the Void Horn hanging at his belt.
bosses.moves: attack: Standard Charge (shoulder charge with the banner-sword); cast: Void Horn Blast (raises the horn); Summon Spectral Legion; charge_ultimate / ultimate: Phantasmal Vanguard Hellstorm (horn to lips, spectral legion swirling).

bosses.name: Abyssal Leviathan
bosses.look: A colossal void leviathan breaching from a lake of liquid silence (body below the sole line hidden in dark water), an armoured head with a huge maw, void tendrils lashing from its sides, star-like pale eyes.
bosses.moves: attack: Tidal Maw (lunging bite); cast: Drowning Silence (tendrils spread, sound draining); Void Spawn; charge_ultimate / ultimate: Abyssal Trench Tsunami (rears into a towering wave).

bosses.name: Grand Inquisitor Malakor, the Mute Sovereign
bosses.look: The final boss (portraits/malakor.jpg): pale face with red eyes, slicked black hair, a silver mesh mouth-guard, a towering high collar, black and gold rune-embroidered robes over armour, spiked pauldrons.
bosses.moves: attack: Sever Echo; cast: Nullifying Word / Choir of Silence (a gesture, silencing sigils); charge_ultimate / ultimate: Cords of Severance (below a third of his health: silver cords lash out from the mouth-guard). Please include a second phase (p2_idle, p2_attack, p2_cast): the mouth-guard torn away, levitating, robes streaming upward.
